description: The github-actions reporter with `silent: false` under Jest 30.5.2 (B23d A4, DV90) and no other reporter: per file the result tree, a passing file in a `::group::` block with its console output under the PASS line, a failing file's lines ungrouped under FAIL, nested describes at their depth, skipped and todo marks, then the last file's `Errors thrown in` group. Annotations and the failure text are left out of the kept lines (their stacks are Jest's own); durations are masked. `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`, one worker, `--ci`. A black-box run; the kept lines are the ones `provino jest` is held to (`provino`'s `jest-github-actions.test.ts`).
